Bank-Math-Master.question: ১) The volume of a right circular cylinder, 14 cm in height is equal to that of a cube whose edge is 11 cm. What is the radius of the base of the cylinder?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: The volume of a right circular cylinder, 14 cm in height is equal to that of a cube whose edge is 11 cm. What is the radius of the base of the cylinder? 

Solution:
Volume of the cylinder = Volume of the cube = (11)3 cm3 = 1331 cm3
Let the radius of the base be r cm
Then,
πr2h = (22/7) × r2 × 14 = 1331
⇒ r2 = 1331/44
⇒ r2 = 121/4
⇒ r = 11/2 = 5.5 cm

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২) The length of the one side of a square is 5√2 cm. What is the length of the diagonal of the square?

Question: The length of the one side of a square is 5√2 cm. What is the length of the diagonal of the square?

Solution:
Given that,

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৪) If the radius of a sphere is doubled, how many times does its volume become?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, how many times does its volume become?

Solution: 
Let the original radius be r. 
Then, original volume = (4/3)πr3

New radius = 2r
∴ New violume = (4/3)π(2r)3
= 8 × (4/3)πr3
= 8 × original volume

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৫) Mr. Shihab moved 3/4th of his lawn in 5/4 hours. Mr. Anik makes twice as fast and finishes the remaining job. How many minutes did Mr. Anik work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Mr. Shihab moved 3/4th of his lawn in 5/4 hours. Mr. Anik makes twice as fast and finishes the remaining job. How many minutes did Mr. Anik work?

Solution: 
Mr. Shihab moved 3/4th of his lawn in 5/4 hours.
Mr. Shihab completed work in (5/4) × (4/3)
= 5/3 hours

Mr. Anik makes twice as fast
Mr. Anik takes time 5/6 hours
= (5/6) × 60 min 
= 50 min to finish the job 

Mr. Anik takes time to finish the remaining job = 50/4 min 
= 12.5 min

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৬) In the diagram, ABCD is a rectangle with AP = PQ = QB. What is the ratio of the areas of ΔCPQ and that of the rectangle?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: In the diagram, ABCD is a rectangle with AP = PQ = QB. What is the ratio of the areas of ΔCPQ and that of the rectangle? 



Solution: 
let, length of rectangle is AB = x m and breadth BC = y m
area = xy m2 

AP = PQ = BQ = x/3

area of ΔCPQ = (1/2) × (PQ) × BC
=  (1/2) × (x/3) × y
= xy/6

ratio = (xy/6) : xy
= 1 : 6

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৭) 5 mat-weavers can wave 5 mats in 5 days. At the same rate, how many mats would be woven by 10 mat-weavers in 10 days?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 5 mat-weavers can wave 5 mats in 5 days. At the same rate, how many mats would be woven by 10 mat-weavers in 10 days? 

Solution: 
5 mat weavers in 5 days wave = 5 mats
∴ 1 mat weavers in 1 day wave = 5/(5 × 5) mats
∴ 10 mat weavers in 10 days wave = (5 × 10 × 10)/(5 × 5)  = 20 mats

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৯) A factory produces 500 bottles of soda in 2 hours. How many bottles will it produce in 6 hours, working at the same rate?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A factory produces 500 bottles of soda in 2 hours. How many bottles will it produce in 6 hours, working at the same rate?

Solution:
Production rate = Number of items produced / Time
Production rate = 500 bottles / 2 hours = 250 bottles per hour

Bottles produced in 6 hours = Production rate × Time
Bottles produced in 6 hours = 250 bottles/hour × 6 hours = 1500 bottles

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১০) The whole surface area of a rectangular block is 8788 sq cm. If length, breadth and height are in the ratio of 4 : 3 : 2, then find the height.
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: The whole surface area of a rectangular block is 8788 sq cm. If length, breadth and height are in the ratio of 4 : 3 : 2, then find the height.

Solution: 
Let length. breadth and height be 4x, 3x and 2x respectively.
Whole surface area = 2(lb + bh + lh)
⇒ (lb + bh + lh) = 8788/2 = 4394
⇒ (4×3 + 3×2 + 2×4) x2=4394
⇒ 26x2 = 4397
⇒ x2 = 169
⇒ x = 13

Therefore, Height = 2x
= 2 × 13
= 26 cm

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১২) A contractor employs 40 persons for doing a job in 60 days. After 20 days it was found that only one-fourth of work was finished. How many more persons are to be employed to finish the job as per schedule?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A contractor employs 40 persons for doing a job in 60 days. After 20 days it was found that only one-fourth of work was finished. How many more persons are to be employed to finish the job as per schedule?

Solution: 
Work remains = 1 - (1/4) part = 3/4 part
Day remaining = 60 - 20 = 40 days

1/4 th work is done in 20 days by 40 person
∴ 1 part is done in 20 days by 40 × 4 person
∴ 1 part is done in 1 day by (40 × 4 × 20) person
∴  3/4 part is done in 40 days by (40 × 4 × 20 × 3)/(40 × 4) = 60 person

∴ He needs = (60 - 40) = 20 more persons.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৪) The ratio of total surface area to lateral surface area of a cylinder whose radius is 25 cm and height 100 cm, is -
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: The ratio of total surface area to lateral surface area of a cylinder whose radius is 25 cm and height 100 cm, is - 

Solution: 
Total surface area : Lateral surface area
= (2πrh + 2πr2) : 2πrh
= (h +r) : h
= (100 + 25) : 100
= 125 : 100
= 5 : 4

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২০) If the diagonal and the area of a rectangle are 25 m and 168 m<sup>2</sup>, what is the width of the rectangle?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If the diagonal and the area of a rectangle are 25 m and 168 m2, what is the width of the rectangle?

Solution: 
let, length x and width y 
area = xy = 168 

diagonal = √(x2 + y2) = 25
⇒ x2 + y2 = 252

(x + y)2 = x2 + 2xy + y2
= 625 + 2 × 168
= 625 + 336
= 961

x + y = √961 = 31 

(x - y)2 = x2 - 2xy + y2
= 625 - 2 × 168
= 625 - 336
= 289

x - y = √289 
= 17 

x + y - x + y = 31 - 17 
⇒ 2y = 14
∴ y = 7 m

Bank-Math-Master.exp:

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২৪) 2 men, working 9 hours a day, can build a dam in 2 days. How many hours a day must 3 men work to build the dam in 1 day?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 2 men, working 9 hours a day, can build a dam in 2 days. How many hours a day must 3 men work to build the dam in 1 day?

Solution:
2 men need 2 days working 9 hours
∴ 1 man needs 2 days working (9 × 2) hours
∴ 1 man needs 1 day working (9 × 2 × 2) hours
∴ 3 men need 1-day working (9 × 2 × 2)/3 hours
= 12 hours

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২৫) A square and an equilateral triangle have equal perimeters. If the one side of the square is 9 cm, then what is the area of the triangle?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A square and an equilateral triangle have equal perimeters. If the one side of the square is 9 cm, then what is the area of the triangle? 

Solution:
Let the side of the square be a cm
⇒ a = 9

The perimeter of the square
= 4a
= 4 × 9
= 36 cm

and also perimeter of the equilateral triangle = 36 cm

Each side of the triangle
= 36/3
= 12

Area of the triangle 
= (√3/4) × (12)2
= 36√3 cm2
